bug_semantics: POST /api/av/getAttributeViewFieldViews is a reader-reachable missing-authorization disclosure (CWE-862). CheckAuth accepts RoleReader (and other authenticated roles) but the route has no CheckReadonly, CheckAdminRole, or publish-access filter. The handler binds caller-supplied avID and keyID (ID-pattern check only), then GetAttributeViewFieldViews parses the AV storage file and returns every view's id, icon, name, layout type, and the requested field's Hidden flag. A publish reader who already sees one embedded database can thus enumerate unpublished views and concealment choices. Sibling getAttributeViewKeys, registered immediately above it, does apply FilterBlockAttributeViewKeysByPublishAccess for read-only roles.
flaw_origin: The endpoint, handler, and unfiltered GetAttributeViewFieldViews were first written in the field-visibility feature commit acfc02ee8a04629c1318da1b21a98432546f09e4 (issue #11020). The new route was registered with CheckAuth only, copying the weaker neighbor pattern without the publish-access gate that getAttributeViewKeys already had. Immediate parent a750d41a602ba13086aba262af5fc53ec5436854 has neither the route nor the functions.

Adds kernel/api/router.go:530 `ginServer.Handle("POST", "/api/av/getAttributeViewFieldViews", model.CheckAuth, getAttributeViewFieldViews)`, handler kernel/api/av.go:732-761, and model kernel/model/attribute_view.go:1904-1928 which returns ID/Icon/Name/Type/Hidden for every attrView.Views entry via av.ParseAttributeView(avID) with no role or publish check. git blame -L 732,761 acfc02ee8 -- kernel/api/av.go is 100% that SHA.

Parent verification: git cat-file -t a750d41a602ba13086aba262af5fc53ec5436854 = commit (tree 17c2aaf8a11f05ca3b4c6177dd216d061d1b39a1). git grep getAttributeViewFieldViews / GetAttributeViewFieldViews on the parent is empty. Parent kernel/api/router.go jumps from getAttributeViewKeys (CheckAuth) to getAttributeViewBacklinks.

At BIC, CheckAuth (kernel/model/session.go) allows RoleAdministrator/RoleEditor/RoleReader. CheckReadonly aborts when util.ReadOnly or IsReadOnlyRoleContext (RoleReader/RoleVisitor). Sibling getAttributeViewKeys (kernel/api/av.go:1107-1131) already filtered via FilterBlockAttributeViewKeysByPublishAccess for read-only roles; the new handler did not.

Fix 64c26e74bb82c24a73513107684b91cc01335fab changes only the route to `model.CheckAuth, model.CheckReadonly, getAttributeViewFieldViews` (kernel/api/router.go:530) and adds TestGetAttributeViewFieldViewsRejectsReader, which sets RoleReader and asserts code -1 plus closeTimeout 5000 (CheckReadonly abort, handler not reached). HEAD still has CheckAuth+CheckReadonly at kernel/api/router.go:572.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2026-72791 is a published CWE-862 record, not withdrawn or vendor-rejected; the vendor GHSA-57v5-wqx3-cgj4 describes the same pre-release endpoint. The sink is the new getAttributeViewFieldViews path: CheckAuth-only routing plus an unfiltered ParseAttributeView dump of every view's name/icon/layout/Hidden. That is a real reader-role information disclosure against partially published databases. The BIC is the first public write of those lines (acfc02ee8), confirmed by -S/-L/blame and by absence of the symbols in parent a750d41a; it is a ordinary single-parent feature commit, so no squash decomposition applies. The direct fix 64c26e74 (message cites GHSA-57v5-wqx3-cgj4) adds CheckReadonly so RoleReader/RoleVisitor never reach the handler, and the regression test proves that abort. Version cross-check: BIC is after v3.7.3, in v3.7.4-alpha.1, and the fix is in v3.7.4-alpha.2 onward (HEAD still gated).
